<subject>Re: Urgent: Settle MediServe invoice by EOD Tues 27/11.    NOTICE OF MEDISERVE SERVICE AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO MEDISERVE IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- I was under the impression that Lumière Santé had met MediServe's credit terms last week; nevertheless, below is an alert indicating that the invoice remains unpaid, and Lumière Santé risks suspension from MediServe clinical networks if payment is not received by 27/11 EOD.

Please advise if Clinical Operations should contact MediServe to resolve this. Jacqueline 37007.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Cousin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 09:20 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: MEDISERVE AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO MEDISERVE IS OVERDUE



FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@pexcorcorp.com [mailto:d992@pexcorcorp.com] 
Sent: Tuesday, 18 November 2025 20:43 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@sollumlabs.com; l184@sollumlabs.com 
Subject: MEDISERVE AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th 
PAYMENT TO MEDISERVE IS OVERDUE 
Importance: High 


> This is your formal notification that MediServe considers your organisation in breach of 
> the MediServe Clinical Service Agreement due to non-payment of your 5 November 2025 invoice 
> by 13:00 today. Under Section 15.1.3 of the Agreement, you have three business days 
> to cure this breach by settling the full outstanding amount. If unresolved by the close of business 
> on Tuesday, 25 November 2025, MediServe will declare default and revoke your participation rights 
> in MediServe governance committees, clinical networks, and access to service provisions. 
> Furthermore, all MediServe partners will be notified tomorrow of members who missed the October billing deadline. 
> 
> For queries about this notice or your balance, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Camille Mallet 
> Controller 
</quoted>
